description: This source file defines a class 'RefundByTransferCommandHandler' which handles 'REFUNDBYTRANSFER' commands for account transfer refunds in the Apache Fineract project. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and delegates the refund process to the 'AccountTransfersWritePlatformService'.

classes.name: RefundByTransferCommandHandler
classes.description: Class that handles refund commands for account transfers. It processes commands of type 'REFUNDBYTRANSFER' and calls the corresponding service to perform the refund operation.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the refund command by delegating to the write platform service's refundByTransfer method.
